fusions.name: Dead Reckoning
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 40 damage, up to 2 times that at its maximum reach of 14 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Muzzle Flash
fusions.desc: A flash and report in a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 14 damage to everything in it, stuns each enemy for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighted Down
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
